Solving inverse kinematics for 57 s of motion…

Right arm eef —

Left arm eef —

Geometry, joint origins and limits come straight from chopped_urdf_v2.urdf. Every reach, grasp and place is a Cartesian target solved by damped-least-squares IK over the carriage and six arm joints, so the hands track the parts exactly; parts ride the right_eef / left_eef frames between grab and release. Keys: space plays or pauses, ← → jump between steps.
